# UjjainTemple.com

> A bilingual (Hindi/English) reference guide to the temples, ghats and pilgrimage
> logistics of Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India — and to Simhastha 2028, the Mahakumbh
> held there once every twelve years.

Ujjain is the city of Shri Mahakaleshwar, the only south-facing of the twelve
Jyotirlingas, on the bank of the Shipra river. This site documents 183 major darshan
temples, the Chaurasi (84) Mahadev circuit, the Shipra ghats, and the travel, stay and
puja arrangements a visiting pilgrim needs. It is published by ByteFlow Technologies
Pvt Ltd and is not affiliated with any temple committee or government body.

## Key facts
- Simhastha 2028 (Ujjain Mahakumbh) runs 27 March – 27 May 2028.
- Its three Shahi Snans fall on 09 April, 23 April and 08 May 2028.
- Seven parv snans are proposed; their dates have not been officially announced.
- These dates follow published media reporting, not a government notification, and
  may be revised — the site states this on the page itself.
- Ujjain's nearest airport is Indore (55 km); Omkareshwar is ~140 km away.

## Pages worth quoting
- [Simhastha 2028 guide](https://ujjaintemple.com/simhastha-2028/): dates, Shahi Snan
  calendar, the 13 akhadas, kalpvas, planning.
- [Simhastha 2028 news](https://ujjaintemple.com/hi/simhastha-2028-news/): dated
  updates on mela construction, snan arrangements, transport and darshan (Hindi).
- [Temples in Ujjain](https://ujjaintemple.com/mandirs/): the full directory, grouped
  by deity, with darshan timings.
- [84 Mahadev of Ujjain](https://ujjaintemple.com/84-mahadev-ujjain/): the Chaurasi
  Mahadev list with addresses.
- [Transport to Ujjain](https://ujjaintemple.com/transport-in-ujjain/): distances and
  routes from Indore, Bhopal, Delhi and Omkareshwar.
- [Hotels in Ujjain](https://ujjaintemple.com/hotels/): where to stay near Mahakaleshwar.
- [Puja in Ujjain](https://ujjaintemple.com/puja-in-ujjain/): Kaal Sarp, Mangal Dosh,
  Navgrah Shanti — what each is and who performs it.

## Hindi
Every page above has a Hindi counterpart under /hi/ — for example
https://ujjaintemple.com/hi/simhastha-2028/. The Hindi tree is the primary one for
Simhastha queries.

## What this site does not claim
- No VIP darshan, Bhasma Aarti booking, or temple-side authorisation.
- No guaranteed outcome from any puja.
- Temple timings are approximate and change on festival days; call to confirm.
